criteria.directional_confirmation: ensemble difference < 0 and at least two of three paired seed differences < 0
criteria.secondary: report all asset/horizon directions, normalized QLIKE, MSE, every fixed comparator and ablation
criteria.uncertainty: 2000 synchronized noncircular moving-block draws; blocks22/44; report95percent intervals
criteria.claims: CI crossing zero allows only a point-improvement claim; no significance or true A/M/IV identification
criteria.mechanism: M has no established development contribution; joint-clock differences do not establish it
criteria.no_rescue: do not replace primary/metric/seed/epoch/asset/horizon using2026; MSE cannot rescue primary failure
criteria.value: judge magnitude and strongest nonoperator comparator separately from numerical direction; no publication guarantee

development_note: Repeated2025 selection; joint epochs11/22/33=10/12/2. This file freezes one later evaluation.
training_scope: labels before2025 only;2025 selected epochs; no2025 refit;2026 updates causal observations only
